question: Can parity-only symmetric stock-conserving deterministic dynamics move, and what addressed extension yields a well-defined tick?

objects.coefficient_domain: F2 labels; Hamming weight in N0

objects.definition: unique-address bit flip and reserve transfer with HOLD guards
objects.exact_expression: theta_p -> 1-theta_p, r -> r+2theta_p-1 if address=e_p and feasible

sources.section_or_object_id: opposite-edge matchings and induced S4 action

sources.source_status: mixed; Q198 conditional, Q205/Q208 quarantined, Q210 NO_GO

assumptions.statement: one tick flips exactly one bit when there is one address and stock available
reserve is nonnegative integer and address is immutable
parity-only no-go assumes deterministic full S4 equivariance and Hamming-weight conservation

technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: eight-state exhaustive check and stock balance
integer tick and conditional period two
no linear amplitude generator or metric

clock_receipt.modulus: none for n; orbit period 2 conditional
clock_receipt.residue_convention: n mod 2 within active two-state orbit
clock_receipt.period_claim: period 2 if one-hot address and N exceeds spectator weight; otherwise period 1

dynamics_readout.state_space: Theta x N0 x Theta, fixed total N finite fiber
dynamics_readout.initial_boundary_conditions: any theta, nonnegative r, any address; no external boundary flux
dynamics_readout.conservation_and_sources: N=|theta|+r; reserve supplies or receives one unit
dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: readout theta and verdict; no information-theoretic claim

calculation_steps: S4 induces S3 on three matchings
stabilizer of 100 swaps other two and fixes only 100 among weight-one words; likewise 011
guard reserve transfer and verify N invariance
classify active period-two and HOLD orbits
enumerate finite sample and S3 covariance

result.exact_expression: f=id under A3; for F under A1-A2, N invariant, F^2=id on states
result.scope: conditional candidate on stated finite/discrete state

counterexamples_and_failures: without reserve, weight conservation blocks every parity-only move
with multi-hot or no address, proposed rule returns HOLD
address is static and no source law prepares it
limitations: candidate flip is imposed, not source-derived
no physical clock, energy, event dataset, or calibration
next_discriminant: independent source preparation of address and reserve, with held-out events or a stronger source theorem
